Wide Night Guard.name: Wide Night Guard
Wide Night Guard.description: In deep darkness, the user directs the enlarged creature through an open street or hall for the rest of the scene. It stays connected to the user while catching falling people, blocking heavy debris and restraining several opponents within its extended reach. Each turn the user must actively command it; a lapse lets it strike whoever is nearest. Bright light drives it back to the user's side. Strain: severe.
